causal_stages.name: PRIOR_INPUTS_AND_PROFILE
causal_stages.rule: Complete context/purpose/profile/subjects and designated birth evidence exist before this boundary. Validate their exact original fields/roles/authority-false guards. No current event output is a prior input.

causal_stages.name: PRIOR_ONLY_ROSTER
causal_stages.rule: Contains complete already-born fact3s only. Context is already born. No self member or member whose typed header/operative payload binds this roster. Previous-event outputs may appear only when they globally precede this new roster with complete prior evidence; local phase values are not compared across events.

causal_stages.name: EVENT_DESCRIPTOR
causal_stages.rule: Binds rank1 roster and prior context/purpose/profile. Descriptor cannot be in its own roster. Its complete whole fact3 anchors every event output.

causal_stages.name: FULL_PROOF
causal_stages.rule: Binds complete descriptor/roster/earlier subjects. Cannot name its own pin or future capsule/adoption.

causal_stages.name: CAPSULE
causal_stages.rule: Binds full-proof WHOLE fact3 directly and same descriptor/roster/earlier subjects. Cannot name itself or future adoption.

causal_stages.name: ROOT_ADOPTION
causal_stages.rule: Binds complete capsule/full directly and both explicit late required subjects; retains all earlier required subject/context coverage. Cannot bind itself or a future consumer/publication.

causal_stages.name: LATER_BOUNDARY
causal_stages.rule: Only a new later roster may include complete earlier full/capsule/adoption outputs. No later record binding that new roster may be among its members. Never mutate an already hashed roster.

edge_and_chronology_rules.birth_boundary: A timestamp/index alone is not birth evidence. Verified new JSON whole bodies provide declared created_utc; legacy/binary subjects require the exact original birth/observation/proof evidence binding. Unmodeled member birth is E_CAUSAL_BIRTH_UNMODELED. This profile/evidence mapping remains unclosed; do not invent it.
edge_and_chronology_rules.edge_direction: consumer -> complete already-born dependency; a SEPARATE GLOBAL topological order must strictly decrease along every typed edge. causal_stages.local_phase values are only within-boundary construction labels, never global rank.
edge_and_chronology_rules.identity_graph: Enumerate all typed identity and operative payload edges under the future complete profile; bound graph by original record/node/depth limits; reject all direct/indirect cycles. No arbitrary Source text/fact3-looking value is automatically an authority edge, and no unknown operative edge may be ignored. Complete global topological ordering is separate from reused local phases. An unresolved/recursive payload-profile bootstrap is not an accepted prior root; it must refuse E_CAUSAL_PROFILE_UNISSUED.
edge_and_chronology_rules.late_links: Full/capsule/adoption outputs born after R0 remain direct whole fact3s in their fixed fields; do not insert them into R0, fabricate future hashes/sizes, or use a null/hash placeholder. Adoption late_required_subjects exactly [capsule,full] is separately present in addition to the direct link fields.
edge_and_chronology_rules.roster_hash_cycle: Reject R0 containing F0 when F0 binds E0 and E0 binds R0, regardless of apparent timestamps. Reject every current consumer of R0 as a member of R0. The final eager raw Store index is separate and may include current outputs; its ordinals are NEVER causal refs.
edge_and_chronology_rules.times: Required member birth <= roster.created <= descriptor.created <= full.created <= capsule.created <= adoption.created <= now. Also validate every original field-specific evidence/time domain. Equality of UTC6 times is allowed only with a strict acyclic recorded dependency order, never as proof of distinctness or physical birth. Local phase numbers are not timestamps or global birth ranks; later-boundary members can have higher local phase than their later consumer. Global order and all recorded time/evidence duties must both hold.

global_causal_order.cost_and_Source_boundary: No expanded legacy JSON, extra mutable cache, shared counter, Source implementation or allowance is introduced. Exact future ordering implementation/readset/node/Source cost remains unproved under all existing caps.
global_causal_order.cycle_error: E_CAUSAL_CYCLE for any complete typed directed cycle or failure to establish a global topological order. E_CAUSAL_SELF_OR_FUTURE for a roster containing itself or its own consumers. Equal times, local phase labels or caller ranks never override refusal.
global_causal_order.edge_completeness: If a mandatory operative edge/profile or its trust bootstrap is unmodeled, E_CAUSAL_PROFILE_UNISSUED blocks qualification. A topological numbering of an incomplete subgraph proves nothing about the whole event.
global_causal_order.formal_witness: For N retained vertices, existence of an injective numbering into builtin integers0..N-1 satisfying every typed edge is the DAG criterion. This is a conceptual validation condition, NOT a new wire field or caller-provided attestation. A future implementation must derive/check complete edges within original bounds; no numbering is issued here.
global_causal_order.global_order: A separate strict topological order over exact whole-fact3 vertices of the COMPLETE finite typed operative dependency graph. For each consumer X -> dependency Y, global_order(Y)<global_order(X). No comparison of reused local phase numbers is made across boundaries.
global_causal_order.later_roster_example: R0 precedesE0 precedesF0 precedesC0 precedesA0 precedesR1 precedesE1. Therefore R1(local_phase1)->A0(local_phase5) is permitted by global order when all prior birth/context/profile duties hold. E1/F1/C1/A1 may NOT be inR1 because they bindR1 and are globally later.
global_causal_order.local_phase: The0..6 values in causal_stages are LOCAL construction labels within one event/boundary, not global rank, timestamp or authority. They may repeat at every boundary; stage6 describes transition to a new boundary.
global_causal_order.recorded_birth_not_physical_authority: Global order alone is not birth evidence. Every original recorded birth/observation/time proof remains independently required; missing evidence is E_CAUSAL_BIRTH_UNMODELED and inverted time is E_CAUSAL_CHRONOLOGY. No native/human/physical provenance is inferred.
